ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in $\circ O$, and $\angle CBE$ is one of its exterior angles. If $\angle CBE=58^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $O$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC+\angle ABC=180^\circ$,\\
since $\angle CBE+\angle ABC=180^\circ$ and $\angle CBE=58^\circ$,\\
then $\angle ADC=\angle CBE=58^\circ$,\\
By the Inscribed Angle Theorem, $\angle AOC=2\angle ADC=\boxed{116^\circ}$.
